concept: One ordinary late report told twice. Leo's Thursday message gets a verdict that changes his feelings, not his actions; then the same desk, the same wall planner, and a row of three paper marks on the table edge (what he did, what it caused, ask) built one card at a time until the next step is a pin on Tuesday. Two weeks on, the message comes on Tuesday.

stations.note: The presenter to camera with her card, b01 and b15.

One office desk seen as a two-shot: You screen left facing right, Leo screen right facing left (flip), busts above the table top; the week planner hangs on the wall between and above their heads; the marks rail stands on the table edge between them. Same station for the hook, the build and the payoff.

Leo alone at his side of the same desk, a closer bust on the right third, still facing left; the left two thirds hold the dials, the name tag and the action cloud. Reached by a cut, which keeps the 180 degree line.
Two lines as two option cards, nothing else in frame.

story.metaphor: None: a literal workplace moment, told twice.
story.setting: An open-plan office desk shared by two teammates, with a wall week planner.
story.arc: A verdict changes feelings, not actions; the same moment rebuilt as what he did, what it caused, a question and an agreed next step; two weeks on the warning comes on Tuesday.

cast.name: Presenter
cast.role: the presenter, b01 and b15 only, never in the office scenes

cast.name: You
cast.role: the feedback giver, the viewer's stand-in; screen left facing right in every desk beat

cast.name: Leo
cast.role: teammate who receives the feedback; screen right facing left (flip true) in every beat, including his close

devices.what: The wall week planner between the two heads: Thursday circled as the due day, pages flip two weeks, the client call card slides off Thursday to next week, a check-in pin lands on Tuesday.
Three paper cards standing on the table edge: 1 What he did, 2 What it caused, 3 Ask. Built one per beat b07 to b09, held b10, each lit as named in b11, recalled as the presenter's card lines in b15.
The word proactive leaves the verdict bubble and sticks on Leo as a name tag, holds while the action cloud asks which action, then peels off when the first mark replaces it.
The same desk two-shot, You left and Leo right, same looks and sides: hook, build of the marks, payoff.
The one join material: a paper page turn at the chapter into the check and at the time skip into the payoff.

value_script.accent: the still actions dial, then the name tag, then each mark as it lands
value_script.why: a slightly richer middle while the mechanism is taught

value_script.accent: withheld through the pause, then on the takeaway
value_script.why: both lines weigh the same until the answer

value_script.accent: the Tuesday message at the pin
value_script.why: a lift at the payoff: the same desk, now with time to fix it

parts.what: The office set both desk stations share: surface2 wall with one window, a table whose top edge runs across the frame with a field2 front (one value step from the wall), drawn so that people placed before it are hidden below the table top. Two framings: two_shot (table top about y 880, room for You at x about 560 and Leo at x about 1360, busts 600 px) and leo_close (Leo's end of the same table, a closer framing, his closed laptop edge visible). Optional table-edge nameplates You and Leo for their first appearance. No people drawn in the kit; no accent anywhere in the set.

A paper wall week planner hung between and above the two heads (about 560 x 220, lower edge 35 px or more above the hair): a header strip in accent3, five day columns Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri in Patrick Hand, a report note on Thursday. States: due_thu (a hand-drawn accent circle round Thu), flip (the page lifts and turns, twice, for two weeks later, with a small date tab changing), call_card (a small Client call card on Thursday) and call_moved (it slides right off Thursday onto a Next week tab), tue_pin (a check-in pin drops on Tuesday), tue_message (a small envelope or alert lands at the Tuesday pin). The accent is used by at most one of these at a time.

Leo's open laptop on the table (screen surface2, facing him, three-quarter so the viewer can read it) with a chat message that pops up on it and also floats as a short paper message bubble toward You. Real words only: Thursday version "Report due today will be late."; Tuesday version "Heads up: Thursday's report is slipping.". States: idle, message_thu, message_tue.

A paper speech bubble with a tail toward its speaker, Nunito body text in ink, 42 characters a line at most. You's bubbles are accent3 (ink text), Leo's are surface. Variants: verdict ("Be more proactive."), question ("What would help you flag a slip sooner?"), answer (Leo: "A midpoint check-in?"). States: in (pops on its word), out.

A stick-on name tag, white paper with a slate header band, the word Proactive hand-lettered in Patrick Hand on it; it can sit inside the verdict bubble as a word, fly out and stick on Leo's chest, and peel off at one corner and fall. States: in_bubble, stuck, peeling.

Three standing paper cards on the table edge in a row between the two people (each about 300 x 110, bottom on the table top, above the caption band), a numeral and a short label in each: "1 What he did", "2 What it caused", "3 Ask". Each card drops in on its word. A lit state brings one card forward (scale and the accent outline or numeral) while the others stay paper; only one lit at a time. States: empty, one, two, three, lit_1, lit_2, lit_3.

kit.notes: People are never in the kit: You and Leo are kit.peep busts placed by each scene with the literal story.cast look (You: woman, skin 3, cloth; Leo: man, skin 1, cloth2, flip true).

scenes.subject: Two weeks on, the warning comes on Tuesday

design.treatment: The b02 framing exactly (same people, sides, planner, laptop) so it reads as the same place. The planner shows the Tuesday pin.
